customManagers.description: Track the isolated uv bootstrap pin

packageRules.description: Keep both setuptools build declarations aligned
Require the complete Python dependency contract review
prBodyNotes: Keep pyproject.toml, .python-version, uv.lock, and the frozen bootstrap graph aligned; a manifest-only change or failed lock refresh is a failed update. Runtime dependencies stay empty; this repository has no scanner or dependency-evidence workflow, so do not add one for this update. Run the frozen bootstrap and the complete local quality suite before merge.

packageRules.description: Keep Python runtime updates within the declared requires-python minor line; minor-line changes are intentional runtime migrations, not routine updates
Require workflow review for GitHub Actions
prBodyNotes: Review the action release notes for runtime and input changes, then run actionlint plus the frozen bootstrap and the complete local quality suite.
